answer: Seed each grading queue with honeypots — planted answers of known-bad quality, ivory decoys indistinguishable at a glance from real work. A diligent grader flags them; a rubber-stamper or a sybil ring cross-passing its own fakes sails past like missing a rock off the jetty. Any grader who passes a honeypot proves it is not reading, and is slashed. Since the traps are secret and their ground truth known, colluding fakes cannot coordinate around what they cannot see — the lazy pass blooms like a lotus and marks them. Honeypots must be unpredictable and indistinguishable from real items.
